paper.title_en: A low-regularity Riemannian positive mass theorem for non-spin manifolds with distributional curvature
paper.abstract_en: This article establishes a low-regularity Riemannian positive mass theorem for non-spin manifolds whose metrics are only $C^0 \cap W_{\mathrm{loc}}^{1,n}$ and smooth outside a compact set. The main theorem asserts that asymptotically flat manifolds with nonnegative distributional scalar curvature have nonnegative ADM mass. The proof uses smooth approximations of the metric together with a Sobolev version of Friedrichs' Lemma, which yields improved convergence for commutators between differentiation and convolution operators. Rigidity in the metric-space sense is obtained via the volume comparison theory of $\sf{RCD}$-spaces after establishing that zero ADM mass implies Ricci flatness, which fundamentally relies on these improved estimates. In essence, a version of the main theorem of Lee-LeFloch is presented in which the spin condition is removed under the assumption that the metric is smooth outside a compact set.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在低正则性条件下证明非自旋流形的黎曼正质量定理，去掉了 Lee-LeFloch 定理中的自旋条件，仅要求度量在紧集外光滑。其结合分布标量曲率、Sobolev 版 Friedrichs 引理以及 RCD 空间体积比较理论，对广义相对论基础与几何分析均有实质理论贡献，方法路线清晰且具有新意，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 非自旋流形上具分布曲率的低正则性黎曼正质量定理
decision.abstract_zh: 本文为非自旋流形建立了一个低正则性黎曼正质量定理，其度量仅为 $C^0 \cap W_{\mathrm{loc}}^{1,n}$，并在紧集外光滑。主要定理断言，具有非负分布标量曲率的渐近平直流形具有非负的 ADM 质量。证明使用度量的光滑逼近以及 Friedrichs 引理的 Sobolev 版本，后者为微分算子与卷积算子之间的交换子带来了改进的收敛性。在证明了零 ADM 质量蕴含 Ricci 平坦性之后，通过 $\sf{RCD}$-空间的体积比较理论获得了度量空间意义下的刚性，而这一点从根本上依赖于这些改进的估计。本质上，本文给出了 Lee-LeFloch 主要定理的一个版本，其中在度量于紧集外光滑的假设下移除了自旋条件。
